def transform(grid):
    g = tuple(map(tuple, grid))
    objs = objects(g, True, True, True)
    kcols = {o: leftmost(o) for o in objs if vline(o)}
    shapes = [o for o in objs if o not in kcols]
    kcolors = [color(o) for o in sorted(kcols, key=kcols.get)]
    out = [[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]   # start blank; repaint shapes & copies
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    for s in shapes:
        c = color(s)
        if c not in kcolors: continue
        p = kcolors.index(c)
        sh = height(s)
        for dcol, drow in ((p-1, -(sh+1)), (p+1, sh+1), (p, 0)):
            if 0 <= dcol < len(kcolors) or drow==0:
                cells = [(i+drow, j) for v,(i,j) in s]
                for i,j in cells: out[i][j] = kcolors[dcol] if drow else c
    return out

        if c not in kcolors: continue
        p = kcolors.index(c); sh = height(s)
        for q, kc in enumerate(kcolors):
            d = q - p
            if d == 0: continue
            drow = d * sh
            cells = [(i+drow, j) for v,(i,j) in s]
            if all(0<=i<h and 0<=j<w for i,j in cells):

    # simpler: sort moves by drow magnitude ascending using stored info; rebuild with d
